blocks.text: Blu Living — Four- and Five-Bedroom Homes by Morgan Creek

parts.t: is a Phoenix Homes community of 64 homes at 15988 32 Avenue, across the street from Morgan Creek Golf Club. The four- and five-bedroom townhomes sit beside detached strata homes, and together they range from about 2,800 to 3,300 square feet.
Interiors were designed with 9-foot ceilings, gas fireplaces, laminate floors and kitchens with stone countertops, limestone backsplashes and shaker cabinets. Homes have large private outdoor areas.

The Shops at Morgan Crossing and Grandview Corners are each about 1.4 km away. Blu Living is in the Morgan Elementary and Grandview Heights Secondary catchments (confirm current catchment with the Surrey Schools school locator).

blocks.text: Bright, Open Spaces with Premium Touches

parts.t: Blu Living homes were finished with 9-foot ceilings, gas fireplaces and laminate floors. Kitchens have stone countertops, limestone backsplashes, glass pendant lights, shaker cabinets and stainless steel appliances.
Bathrooms have porcelain tile floors, marble countertops and jetted soaker tubs. Each home has a large, private outdoor area.
Blu Living is registered as strata plan BCS4099. Confirm what the monthly fees cover, and review the bylaws, depreciation report and minutes before you buy.
If you're buying to rent, confirm the current strata bylaws first; rules can change.

blocks.text: Grandview Surrey — South Surrey's Most Connected Community

parts.t: Blu Living is on 32 Avenue in the Morgan Creek area, across from Morgan Creek Golf Club. Distances and drive times below are approximate.
Grandview Surrey and Morgan Creek offer shopping at Morgan Crossing and Grandview Corners, the Grandview Heights Aquatic Centre, golf at Morgan Creek and access to Highway 99.
What is the price range for Blu Living Townhomes in South Surrey?
Prices vary by unit and change with the market. Contact Jared for recent Blu Living sales and current listings.
How large are the units at Blu Living?
Blu Living has four- and five-bedroom townhomes beside detached strata homes; together they range from about 2,800 to 3,300 square feet. Contact Jared for the exact size of a specific unit.
Can Blu Living homes be rented out?

Under BC's Strata Property Act amendments effective November 24, 2022, residential strata corporations cannot restrict long-term rentals, so Blu Living homes can be rented long term. Short-term rentals (such as Airbnb or VRBO) remain subject to strata bylaws and municipal licensing. Buyers should review the current strata bylaws, Form B, and recent strata minutes before purchasing.
What schools are in the Blu Living catchment?

Blu Living is in the Morgan Elementary and Grandview Heights Secondary catchments (confirm current catchment with the Surrey Schools school locator). Southridge School, an independent K-12 school, is at 2656 160 Street.
How do Blu Living townhomes compare to other Grandview Surrey communities?
Blu Living's floor plans are large, at roughly 2,800 to 3,300 square feet with four or five bedrooms. Jared can walk you through a side-by-side comparison with other communities in the area.
Are there homes for sale at Blu Living right now?
Listings at Blu Living come and go quickly. Check the South Surrey townhome search above, or call or text me at 604-928-1361 and I'll set up an alert for new Blu Living listings.
What should I check before buying at Blu Living?
Ask for the Form B information certificate, the strata bylaws and rules, the last two years of minutes and the depreciation report. I review these with every buyer before subjects are removed.
